chapter.verse: Tua lai takin siahdongte leh migilote khempeuh in Zeisu’ thu ngai dingin a kiangah a nai uh hi.
Farisaite leh laitheite in, “Hihpa in migilote ngai a, amau tawh an a nekhawm hi,’ ci-in a ko uh hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in hih thugentehna a gen-inah,
“Mi khat in tuu zakhat nei a, tuu khat a man’sak leh, tuu sawmkua leh kua gam lakah nusia-in a mang tuu khat a muh matengin a zong lo ding note lakah kua ahi hiam?
A muh kik ciangin lungdamin a liangko ah pua a, inn a tun’ ciangin,
a lawmte leh a inn veengte sam a, ‘Hong lungdampih ta un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka man’suahsa tuu ka mukik zo hi,’ a ci hi.
Ke’n kong cih-inah, tua bangin vantungah kisikkikna kisam a kisa lo sawmkua leh kuate sangin, mawhna a kisik migilo khat tungah nuamna a lianzaw hi.”
“Lam khat panin, numei khat in dangka sawm nei a, khat a man’suah leh’ meivak vakin a muh matengin a inn phiatin a zong kawikawi lo ding kua ahi hiam?
A muhkik ciangin a lawmte leh a inn veengte sam a, ‘Hong lungdampih ta un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka man’suahsa dangka ka mukik zo hi,’ a ci hi.
Ke’n kong cih-inah, tua mah bangin a kisikkik mawhneipa khat hangin Pasian’ vantungmite’ omna munah nuamna a om ding hi,” a ci hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in, “Mi khat in tapa nih a nei hi.
A taneu in a pa kiangah va pai a, ‘Pa aw, ka ngah dinga kilawm luahna sum hong pia in,’ ci-in a ngen hi. A pa in a tate tungah a sum hawmsak hi.
Tua nung ciangin sawtvei kihal loin a taneu in ama sum khempeuh khawm a, gamlapi gamah pai-in tua santak ah noptatna lamsang uang lua ahih ciangin, a sum teng a zang khin hi.
A sum khempeuh a beikhit ciangin tua gamah nakpi-in kial tung a, amah in nakpi a zawng hi.
Tua lai takin amah pai-in tua gam mi khat beel a, vok cing dingin a topa in lo lamah a sawl hi.
Amah in vok an nek begapte nangawn duhgawhin a nekpih nuam hi. Ahih hangin kuamah in an a pia kei hi.
A lungngaih kik ciangin, ‘Ka pa’ inn sungah nasemte khamval bangzah tak a om hiam! Kei ka hih leh hih gamah gilkialin puksi dek takin ka om hi.
Kei thoin ciah ning! Ka pa kiangah, ‘Pa aw, Pasian tung leh nangma mai-ah ka khial zo hi.
Tu-a kipanin na ta kicih nadingin ka kilawm kei hi. Nangma nasemte khat mah bangin hong koih in, ka ci ding hi,’ a ci hi.
Tua lai takin tho a, a pa kiangah va ciah hi. Ahih hangin inn pan gamlapi-ah a om lai takin a pa in mu a, hehpihhuai sa-in delh meengmeeng a, a ta ngawngkawi-in a nam hi.
A ta in, ‘Pa aw, Pasian tung leh nangma mai-ah ka khial zo hi. Tu-a kipanin na ta kicih nadingin ka kilawm kei hi,’ a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a pa in, ‘Puan hoih bel hong la meengmeeng un la, silhsak un. Ama khut ah zungbuhte hong butsak un.
Khedap zong bulhsak un. Bawngno a thau hong paipihin go un la, an ne-in nuamsa ni.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a sisa ka tapa a nungta kik hi. A mangsa ahih hangin tu-in kimu kik hi,’ ci-in a nasemte a sawl hi. Amaute in lungdamin pawi a kham uh hi.”
“A tapa lianzaw in lo kuanin a om hi. Amah hong ciah a, inn a naih ciangin lasakna leh laamna hu ging a za hi.
Nasemte khat sam a, ‘Hih a ging bang ahi hiam?’ ci-in a dong hi.
Nasempa in, ‘Na naupa hong ciah zo hi. Cidamin na pa in mu kik ahih ciangin bawngno thau a go zo hi,’ ci-in a gen hi.
Ahih hangin amah heh a, inn sungah a lut nuam kei hi. A pa pusuakin a zol hi.

A ta in, ‘Hih tanvei, kum sawtpi nangma na ka sem zo hi. Nangma thukham khat beek ka khial kei hi. Ahih hangin ka lawmte tawh nopna ka bawl nadingin keelno khat zong khatvei beek nong pia ngei kei hi.
Ahih hangin numei gilote tawh kikhawla na sum na pai a mangsak, na tapa hong tun’ ciangin ama ading bawngno thau na gawhsak hi,’ a ci hi.
A pa in, ‘Ta aw, keimah tawh na om tawntung a, ka neih ka lam khempeuh nangma neih nangma lam ahi hi.
Ahih hangin, na nau ahih leh tuma-in a si hi, tu-in a nungta kik hi. Tuma-in a mang hi, tu-in a kimu kik ahih man-inah nopna leh lungdamna bawl tuak hi,’ ci-in a gen hi,” ci-in a hilh hi.
